title: Malteser Traybake
description: A childhood party classic — white chocolate and butter melted together with crushed Maltesers, set in a tray and cut into sweet squares.
steps: Grease and line a 25cm x 18cm baking tray.
Melt the white chocolate over a saucepan of boiling water or in the microwave in 20-second bursts. Add the butter and let it melt in, stirring regularly.
Crush two-thirds of the Maltesers in a ziplock bag and tip into a big bowl. Allow the melted chocolate mixture to cool slightly before pouring over the Maltesers. Stir quickly.
Tip into the baking tray, press remaining whole Maltesers into the top.
Refrigerate for 2–3 hours before slicing into small squares.
